quick_use.use_when: A team needs a compact shared frame before actor mapping, context mapping, thresholding, service topology, examples, or AI-assisted artifact generation.
quick_use.restores: Shared orientation around purpose, objectives, discoverables, and activities.
quick_use.good_next_question: What should become discoverable before we commit to artifact, workflow, diagram, prototype, or implementation form?

purpose.text: Keep table comparisons readable and verification evidence attached to its actual scope.
purpose.reason: Choose explicit coverage and evidence-reopening dimensions.

objectives.label: Readable comparisons
objectives.text: Preserve native relationships, useful column measures and local scrolling.
objectives.reason: Route one named uncertainty to its next observation.

objectives.label: Protective verification
objectives.text: Keep passing checks bounded and reopen affected evidence.
objectives.reason: Route one named uncertainty to its next observation.

discoverables.label: Actual inner widths
discoverables.text: Measure parent and iframe before choosing a breakpoint.
discoverables.reason: Route one named uncertainty to its next observation.

discoverables.label: Reopening boundary
discoverables.text: Identify evidence invalidated by a new finding.
discoverables.reason: Route one named uncertainty to its next observation.

activities.label: Measure parent and child
activities.text: Observe narrow and desktop carriers and record child widths.
activities.reason: Route one named uncertainty to its next observation.

activities.label: Record a bounded check receipt
activities.text: Attach scope, revision, fixture and remaining gap to the check.
activities.reason: Route one named uncertainty to its next observation.

preferred_phrasing: Which activity helps surface this discoverable?
Which objective does this discoverable support?
What purpose gives this work meaning?
Which architecture should receive this discoverable next?

activities multiply without a shared reason
deliverable-shaped language appears before discoverable surfaces are clear
